## ecfr-17-cfr-230-501-accredited-income

- **Source:** 17 CFR 230.501: Accredited investor: income, U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (eCFR, Office of the Federal Register)
- **URL:** https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-17/chapter-II/part-230/section-230.501
- **Supports:** A natural person with income over $200,000 (or $300,000 joint) in each of the last two years, expecting the same this year, is an accredited investor.
- **Quote:** "Any natural person who had an individual income in excess of $200,000 in each of the two most recent years or joint income with that person's spouse or spousal equivalent in excess of $300,000 in each of those years and has a reasonable expectation of reaching the same income level in the current year;"
- **Checked:** 2026-11-26 · **Re-check by:** 2027-02-26

## ecfr-17-cfr-230-501-accredited-net-worth

- **Source:** 17 CFR 230.501: Accredited investor: net worth, U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (eCFR, Office of the Federal Register)
- **URL:** https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-17/chapter-II/part-230/section-230.501
- **Supports:** A natural person with net worth over $1 million (alone or with a spouse or spousal equivalent) is an accredited investor.
- **Quote:** "Any natural person whose individual net worth, or joint net worth with that person's spouse or spousal equivalent, exceeds $1,000,000;"
- **Checked:** 2026-11-26 · **Re-check by:** 2027-02-26

## ecfr-17-cfr-230-502-general-solicitation

- **Source:** 17 CFR 230.502: Limitation on manner of offering, U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (eCFR, Office of the Federal Register)
- **URL:** https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-17/chapter-II/part-230/section-230.502
- **Supports:** Outside Rule 506(c) (and a narrow Rule 504 case), a Regulation D issuer may not use general solicitation or advertising.
- **Quote:** "Except as provided in § 230.504(b)(1) or § 230.506(c), neither the issuer nor any person acting on its behalf shall offer or sell the securities by any form of general solicitation or general advertising"
- **Checked:** 2026-11-26 · **Re-check by:** 2027-02-26

## ecfr-17-cfr-230-502-information

- **Source:** 17 CFR 230.502: Information requirements, U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (eCFR, Office of the Federal Register)
- **URL:** https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-17/chapter-II/part-230/section-230.502
- **Supports:** A Rule 506(b) issuer that sells to a non-accredited investor must give that investor specified information before the sale.
- **Quote:** "If the issuer sells securities under § 230.506(b) to any purchaser that is not an accredited investor, the issuer shall furnish the information specified in paragraph (b)(2) of this section to such purchaser a reasonable time prior to sale."
- **Checked:** 2026-11-26 · **Re-check by:** 2027-02-26

## ecfr-17-cfr-230-503-form-d

- **Source:** 17 CFR 230.503: Filing of notice of sales, U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (eCFR, Office of the Federal Register)
- **URL:** https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-17/chapter-II/part-230/section-230.503
- **Supports:** A Rule 506 issuer files Form D within 15 calendar days after the first sale.
- **Quote:** "must file with the Commission a notice of sales containing the information required by Form D (17 CFR 239.500) for each new offering of securities no later than 15 calendar days after the first sale of securities in the offering"

## ecfr-17-cfr-230-506-b-purchasers

- **Source:** 17 CFR 230.506: Rule 506(b) number of purchasers, U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (eCFR, Office of the Federal Register)
- **URL:** https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-17/chapter-II/part-230/section-230.506
- **Supports:** Rule 506(b) limits an offering to 35 purchasers in any 90 days, counted as Rule 501(e) provides.
- **Quote:** "There are no more than, or the issuer reasonably believes that there are no more than, 35 purchasers of securities from the issuer in offerings under this section in any 90-calendar-day period."
- **Checked:** 2026-11-26 · **Re-check by:** 2027-02-26

## ecfr-17-cfr-230-506-b-sophistication

- **Source:** 17 CFR 230.506: Rule 506(b) nature of purchasers, U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (eCFR, Office of the Federal Register)
- **URL:** https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-17/chapter-II/part-230/section-230.506
- **Supports:** Each non-accredited purchaser in a Rule 506(b) offering must be financially sophisticated, alone or with a representative.
- **Quote:** "Each purchaser who is not an accredited investor either alone or with his purchaser representative(s) has such knowledge and experience in financial and business matters that he is capable of evaluating the merits and risks of the prospective investment"
- **Checked:** 2026-11-26 · **Re-check by:** 2027-02-26

## ecfr-17-cfr-230-506-c-accredited

- **Source:** 17 CFR 230.506: Rule 506(c) purchasers and verification, U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (eCFR, Office of the Federal Register)
- **URL:** https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-17/chapter-II/part-230/section-230.506
- **Supports:** Every purchaser in a Rule 506(c) offering must be an accredited investor.
- **Quote:** "All purchasers of securities sold in any offering under paragraph (c) of this section are accredited investors."
- **Checked:** 2026-11-26 · **Re-check by:** 2027-02-26

## ecfr-17-cfr-230-506-c-verification

- **Source:** 17 CFR 230.506: Rule 506(c) verification, U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (eCFR, Office of the Federal Register)
- **URL:** https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-17/chapter-II/part-230/section-230.506
- **Supports:** A Rule 506(c) issuer must take reasonable steps to verify that each purchaser is accredited.
- **Quote:** "The issuer shall take reasonable steps to verify that purchasers of securities sold in any offering under paragraph (c) of this section are accredited investors."
